components.name: FeedbackWidget
components.doc: A floating feedback button that grows into a small form, from its own corner, on a layout spring. Pick a mood (the highlight glides between faces), add a note, and the button walks through sending into a drawn check and a thank-you. Escape or a click outside closes it and returns focus to the button.

defaults.label: "Feedback"
defaults.title: "How is it going?"
defaults.thanksMessage: "Your feedback goes straight to the team."

components.name: FeedbackWidgetPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: a help article with the widget in its corner.

members.name: onSubmit
members.doc: Receives the feedback. Return a promise to hold the sending state until it settles; reject it to show an error and keep the form.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the form opens or closes.

members.name: contained
members.doc: Pins the widget inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the window, for panels and previews.
